tiqui0.m: You not belong here. You leave now.
r: I am sent here by Aulowenn to take care of you.

tiqui1.m: Tiqui not want fight. Tiqui angry that men who smell bad kill his friends.
r: I won't listen to any of your lies. You'll die now!

tiqui10.m: Smelly men hunt us down. Kill many.
r: The smelly men you speak of must be the guards from Feygard. They've been killing you off?
I won't listen to any more of your lies. You'll die now!

tiqui11.m: Yes. Smelly men kill us when they see us.
r: I won't listen to any more of your lies. You'll die now!
What can I do to help?

tiqui12.m: You help Tiqui? Tiqui want revenge for dead friends.

tiqui13.m: Tiqui knows smelly person with crates [points in the direction to where Aulowenn is].

tiqui14.m: You go take care of last smelly person. Tiqui can be friend to you. Tiqui can have revenge.
r: I won't listen to any more of your lies. You'll die now!
I will gladly kill more of those Feygard scum.
No, I think I'll find your village and take whatever riches you have instead.
It sounds like they have been wrongfully killing you. I will help you.

tiqui2.m: They did. Men who smell bad do not belong here. Everything quiet before they came.
r: I won't listen to any of your lies. You'll die now!

tiqui3.m: You can smell them from far away even. We sense something bad would happen when we first noticed them.

tiqui4.m: First we try stay away from them. They notice us, but we stay away. They trespass deeper.

tiqui5.m: One smelly man walked into snake trap. Snake trap not meant for smelly man.

tiqui6.m: Other smelly men angry at snake trap. Tiqui not understand. Smelly men should be angry at stupid man who walk into snake trap.

tiqui7.m: After, smelly men angry at us. Hunt us. Kill us.

tiqui8.m: Much fight. Much blood on ground. But blood good for trees.

tiqui9.m: Tiqui head of clan. Tiqui make decision of revenge.

tiqui_atk0.m: No, you die now! You one of them! Tiqui angry!
r: Sorry, I wasn't listening since I was so distracted by your hideous appearance and your foul smell. Here, let me fix your face with my dagger.

tiqui_r0.m: Hello, friend of Tiqui. Can Tiqui have revenge for friends?
r: I won't listen to any more of your lies. You'll die now!
Can you tell me your story again?
I've dealt with Aulowenn for you.

tiqui_r1.m: Yes! Yes! The smell is gone. You friend of Tiqui now! Tiqui help you when we meet again!

tiqui_r2.m: You also use bed of smelly men, and Tiqui keep you safe.
r: Thank you. I'll feel much safer now that I know you'll watch over me when I rest in Aulowenn's old bed.

tiqui_wb0.m: My helping friend! Thank you, thank you!

lodar13_rest.10: In the maze of green vines east of the Duleian road, I met a guard named Aulowenn from Feygard, guarding some crates. She told me that she was part of a larger group of guards searching for a madman that supposedly hides somewhere in the nearby hills, but that the other guards are now dead or missing.
lodar13_rest.11: Aulowenn requested my help in defeating a monster that haunts the grave of her fellow guards to the east. She warned me that the foul beast will most likely try to trick me into listening to its story.
lodar13_rest.20: I have met the creature that Aulowenn spoke of.
lodar13_rest.22: I listened to the creature's story. Its name is Tiqui, and he is the head of his clan. Apparently, the guards have been ruthlessly killing off his kin. He asked me to kill the guard for him, as revenge for what they have done.
lodar13_rest.24: The creature tried to trick me into listening to its story.
lodar13_rest.30: I attacked the creature before it could spew out more of its foul lies.
lodar13_rest.40: Aulowenn thanked me for bringing peace to the grave of her fallen companions by killing the creature.
lodar13_rest.41: Tiqui was overjoyed that I helped him kill the guard for him. He promised that if we ever run into each other again, he'd help me somehow.
lodar13_rest.60: I am now able to use Aulowenn's bed whenever I wish to rest.
lodar13_rest.65: I will not be able to resolve the conflict between Aulowenn and her attacker.
